Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE new reusable FAIRY PITTA mascot (Pitta nympha / ヤイロチョウ), not an Indian pitta, parrot, or yellow chick. Both inputs are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY. Match the existing yellow bird's warm brown ink, soft watercolor-paper fills, compact friendly body, small simple dark eye, and relaxed standing stance; the cat reinforces the same family texture/line quality, not cat anatomy.
Species colors and anatomy: chestnut-brown crown with a narrow black central crown stripe; a clear pale cream eyebrow above a black eye-band; pale cream/buff throat, breast and flanks; rich leafy green back/shoulders; small cobalt-blue wing/rump accents; red restricted to the LOWER CENTRAL BELLY and vent, not the entire breast; extremely SHORT dark tail; two fairly strong pinkish-brown legs and small toes; a short pointed charcoal beak. Show these identifying marks in a friendly simple left-facing three-quarter bird with folded wings. No large hooked bill, long tail or invented rainbow stripes. Do not turn it into a mammal or add arm-like hands.
Full body at roughly the same source body height as the yellow bird reference(about650–750px on a1254-square canvas), with generous clear margins. Match its outer ink weight at a normal280px body display height (around6–7px on screen, approximately16–18 source pixels here). Use warm chestnut brown close to#793705, not thick black outlines; fine beak and toe details remain readable. Real transparent RGBA outside the bird and between legs. No white background, painted checkerboard, halo, shadow, text, labels, scenery, clothing or other creatures.
